Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using FLAG-tagged baits (KCTD7 and CLN5) to identify interacting partners. Acquisition was DDA. While the study discusses ubiquitination and glycosylation in the biology section, the specific MS dataset described in the PRIDE metadata is for the AP-MS interaction screen, not a remnant-peptide enrichment (like diGly or QQTGG) or a glycoproteomics run.

cell_lines: HeLa cells with endogenous FLAG-tagged KCTD7 were harvested and lysed
scope: combined CRISPR-Cas9–mediated gene tagging and affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry (AP-MS) to identify potential KCTD7-interacting partners
KCTD7 protein complexes were purified and identified by AP-MS
WCLs were incubated with anti-FLAG antibody-conjugated M2 agarose beads (Sigma-Aldrich) at 4°C overnight to capture FLAG-tagged KCTD7
Overexpressed CLN5 were tagged by FLAG and then purified by TAP with FLAG M2 beads. Then the product is sbujected to MS to ananlyze the interaction proteins with CLN5.
